From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: Milliard and milliárd

English

[edit]
English numbers (edit)
 ←  1,000,000 (106) [a], [b] ←  100,000,000 (108) 1,000,000,000 (109) 1012  → [a], [b] 1015  → [a], [b]
    Cardinal: billion, milliard, thousand million
    Ordinal: billionth, milliardth, thousand-millionth
    Multiplier: billionfold, milliardfold, thousand-millionfold
    Metric collective prefix: giga-
    Metric fractional prefix: nano-
    Number of years: giga-annum, gigayear

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French milliard.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (UK) IPA(key): /ˈmɪlɪɑːd/
  • (US) IPA(key): /ˈmɪliɑɹd/
  • Audio (UK):(file)
  • Hyphenation: mil‧liard

Numeral

[edit]

milliard (plural milliards)

  2. (now rare) 10⁹, a thousand (times a) million. (Now generally replaced by the short scale billion.) [from 18th c.]
    Synonyms: billion (short scale), thousand million
    • 1977, Alistair Horne, A Savage War of Peace, New York: Review Books, published 2006, page 155:
      For the coming year France would contribute 80 milliard francs ($200 million) to the Algerian budget [...].

Coordinate terms

[edit]
  • thousand
  • million
  • thousand million
  • billion
  • trillion
  • quadrillion
  • quintillion
  • sextillion

Derived terms

[edit]
  • milliardaire
  • milliardfold
  • milliardth

Translations

[edit]
10^9 — see billion

See also

[edit]
  • Previous: million. Next: billion.
  • Symbolic: 109 = 1,000,000,000

Anagrams

[edit]
  • millirad
